summary: Graham County lookout listed as Hayce (Haoe) and as Hayoe Bald; entries are undated and no source describes the site now.

facts.status_note: No source says whether a lookout structure or cabin survives on the bald

notes_for_editor: Story is about 100 words, below the 120-word floor, because the evidence is two list entries: a name and coordinates from tnlandforms, and an undated Forest Lookouts entry. No build, staffing, fire or fate evidence was found in two searches. The sentence that the two names probably refer to one site is an inference from matching Graham County entries; sources do not say so. A 2025 wildfire named Haoe Lead (Joyce Kilmer-Slickrock Wilderness, Cheoah Ranger District, Nantahala NF; FOX Carolina and inciweb reports) shares the name, but no source ties it to the lookout, so it is left out. Next leads: the D.H. Ramsay Library / UNCA photo record for Hayoe Bald, Peter Barr's 2021 book on the state's towers, and NC Forest Service records. Brief status unknown, left as is.
